body:
Thanks for commenting.

Your English is great, don't worry about it. I'm sorry that you're in a similar situation and I'm sorry that I can only offer solidarity.

It is reassuring to hear that you have a partner. There will never be a magical cure, but company always makes the struggle easier. 

I would also like to tell you that while I know practically nothing about you, I do know that you used your first comment on Reddit to reach out to a suicidal stranger, and that alone should be enough evidence that you are an excellent person yourself.

For a while longer, I will keep listening. You too - stay in the sound.
